exposure: trial of labor after a cesarean section (TOLAC)
Complete uterine rupture during trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC)
cohort: 175 women with complete uterine rupture during TOLAC at term (cases) and 272 women with no uterine rupture during TOLAC at term (controls) in Denmark between 1997 and 2008
finding: Women who experience a complete uterine rupture during TOLAC have a higher risk of miscarriage and uterine rupture in subsequent pregnancies, but maternal and fetal outcomes are generally good when managed with cesarean delivery.
